text:
amy_sales: Heads upPOC with MediPulse tomorrow AM. Their demo is streaming a 60s generation and it drops around 28-35s with 'socket hang up' or 502. They say it only happens from their corp network behind a proxy. Can eng/infra swarm?
dan_se: Are they using Node/TS or Python SDK? Any sample request?
amy_sales: TS. They shared minimal repro using node-fetch.
```
await fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer REDACT' },
  body: JSON.stringify({ model: 'rw-13b', messages: [...] }),
  timeout: 60000,
});
```
eric_backend: Likely corporate proxy is dropping idle upstream keepalive during long chunked responses. Node default agent closes sockets.
tina_infra: Confirm: some proxies do idle-connection GC ~30s. If the client doesn't use keepAlive, the proxy will treat the upstream connection as stale when streaming and reset.
dan_se: Quick try: use https-proxy-agent with keepAlive true and set freeSocketTimeout/timeout > stream length. Example (node-fetch / axios):
```
import HttpsProxyAgent from 'https-proxy-agent';
const agent = new HttpsProxyAgent({ keepAlive: true, timeout: 120000 });
await fetch(url, { agent, ... });
```
eric_backend: Also set request timeout > expected stream time and enable streaming consumption early (pipe data instead of buffering).
amy_sales: Customer says they cannot change proxy TTLs (corporate policy). Any server-side workarounds for POC demo?
\ertina: (typo)
tina_infra: Short-term: recommend polling (non-stream) for the demo so entire generation response completes over a single response instead of a long-lived chunked stream. Also reduce max_tokens so jobs finish <25s if possible.
eric_backend: For longer-term we can build resumable streaming in SDK: prefix-based resume or token checkpointing. That's a product dev item.
dan_se: On gateway side we could detect upstream reset mid-stream and map to a specific error header x-redwood-upstream: stream-reset so SDK can retry gracefully where safe. Needs coordination.
deploy-bot: deployment: gateway v1.43.1 rolled at 2026-03-20T05:12:09Z by ci-deploy (no proxy config changes).
\amy_sales: They asked about cost/pricing delta between streaming vs polling for demo. Quick answer?
\eran: (typo)
eric_backend: For a single demo call, difference negligible. Streaming only changes latency/UX, tokens charged are same for full generation. Polling adds a tiny bit if client retries. For production, Optimize suggestions (batching/caching) reduce cost.
\amy_sales: Also security question: their security team performs TLS inspection (MITM). Will that break anything?
tina_infra: If their proxy intercepts TLS, cert pinning could fail. Our hosted endpoints work with standard TLS. For enterprise we support mTLS and private deployment, but for POC recommend using HTTPS_PROXY env var and no client cert pinning.
amy_sales: Plan for now: 1) Send agent snippet + increase client timeout to 120s to customer. 2) If fails, run demo using non-streaming endpoint. 3) Schedule follow-up to scope SDK resumable streaming and gateway retry header.
dan_se: I'll prep a 1-paragraph handout for the customer with the agent code, timeouts, and a note about proxy inspection and demo fallback.
amy_sales: Customer agreed to polling for tomorrow. Marking triaged, will update opportunity stage and attach the handout. :white_check_mark:
